codeReview.summary: The implementation fully covers the feature contract. It replaces fragmented hot-path fetching with a batched createWorkspaceContentController that owns a 7-entry LRU cache (LruMap class), deduplicates in-flight fetches via a request-version mutex, handles workspace-content-mutated invalidation, and properly manages concurrent invalidations without state corruption. Four unit tests cover all critical paths: concurrent fetch deduplication, LRU eviction at 7 entries, stale in-flight invalidation, and hub-coupled invalidation. The full test suite (398 tests) and TypeScript check both pass. One non-blocking issue: the skill example uses `--grep` which this Vitest version does not support.

summary: Feature w1-a3-cache-contract passes scrutiny. The implementation correctly replaces fragmented hot-path fetching with a bounded 7-entry LRU cache (LruMap), batched content query via createWorkspaceContentController, deduplicated concurrent fetches using a mutationVersion mutex, and proper invalidation on workspace-content-mutated events. Cache survives workspace switches (shared controller owned by the canvas component), concurrent invalidations are handled via requestVersion/mutationVersion versioning, and all four cache-specific tests pass.
